claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Icariin is a prenylated flavonol glycoside with no reported cytotoxicity at 2.5 uM; its PDE5 inhibition and anti-inflammatory/osteogenic activities are cytostatic or cytoprotective rather than cytotoxic, so it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen.
